subject: Isolated deployment prototype: scope & ops asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Foster <matthew.foster@catalystanalytics.com>, catalyst-ops@catalystanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Isolated deployment prototype: scope & ops asks

Team —

Thanks for carving out time. Catalyst reached back with a firm request to prototype an isolated (VPC/on-prem) variant of our runtime for a short internal POC. They want a clear scoping doc, the minimal operations runbook, and a staffing ask so they can budget for the pilot. I attached a refined scope (isolation-prototype-scope-v2.pdf) and a first-draft ops runbook (ops-runbook-draft.md).

High-level asks from my side:
- Quick technical feasibility: major integration blockers (KMS, audit logs, private registry, egress controls) — Soojin
- Ops & staffing: minimal oncall + escalation path and where Redwood must provide runbook / remote ops support — Rishi / Marissa
- POC schedule: propose 3-day on-prem POC window and a follow-up demo; Catalyst wants target week of Sep 4–8.

Specific constraints from Catalyst: no outbound traffic except to our customer-managed NTP and KMS endpoints; all logs must be retained in their SIEM; legal asked for no managed backups outside customer network.

Please review attachments and reply with: (a) top 5 architecture risks, (b) estimated FTEs and weeks to stable pilot, (c) what we cannot do without product changes.

I can host a 30-min sync tomorrow (Aug 17 10:00 PDT) if that helps.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: isolation-prototype-scope-v2.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); ops-runbook-draft.md (text, 18KB)

On Thu, Aug 16, 2028 at 9:10 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Thanks for carving out time. Catalyst reached back with a firm request to prototype an isolated (VPC/on-prem) variant of our runtime for a short internal POC. They want a clear scoping doc, the minimal operations runbook, and a staffing ask so they can budget for the pilot. I attached a refined scope (isolation-prototype-scope-v2.pdf) and a first-draft ops runbook (ops-runbook-draft.md).

Quick notes from an architecture perspective (top risks first):
1) KMS and HSM integration surface: if Catalyst expects to run with their HSM and we must not hold keys, we need a supported KMS shim in the control plane or an API to pass wrapped keys at boot. Without that, we cannot meet the "no managed backups" constraint.
2) Networking: egress lock-down is doable but will break our plugin-update jobs and image pulls. We need an inbound/outbound exception window or a pre-staged private registry in their network.
3) KV cache and continuous batching: to reach acceptable latencies we'll need local shard caches and disk-backed checkpoints. That increases operator complexity and disk IOPS requirements for the host.
4) Observability: shipping telemetry into their SIEM is fine, but we must ensure traces/sampled logs don't leak token contents — need field-level redaction at the collector.
5) Upgrade/rollbacks: no automated fallback to hosted models if private runtime can't access network — requires a manual fallback playbook and playbooks for rolling back quantized kernel changes.

What we cannot do today without changes: hot key rotation via customer HSM during runtime; seamless auto-upgrade without a brief outbound window; 100% guaranteed zero-evidence cold-start (we can approach it but need product safeguards).

I'll sketch a minimal architecture diagram and a short runbook note by tomorrow EOD.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal Architect, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment prototype: scope & ops asks

Jonas / Soojin —

Thanks for the clear ask. Operational staffing estimate for a short POC (3–5 days) + a stabilization week:
- Minimum dedicated coverage: 2x SRE (one primary, one backup) for the POC window (12-hour rotation) to handle networking, image pulls, and telemetry pipelines.
- One infra engineer for pre-staging images, building the air-gapped registry, and testing KMS/HSM handshake (1.5 FTE-weeks).
- One support/solutions engineer to run the demo and customer ops playbook (0.5 FTE-weeks).

If Catalyst wants 24/7 monitoring for the stabilization week, add 1x SRE for the week. Cost ballpark (contractor rates): $35k–$55k for the pilot staffing (depending on overnight coverage). Hiring permanent FTEs would take 8–12 weeks.

Blocking dependencies:
- We need a consented exception to our auto-updater; security must sign off on a manual image patch process (Marissa take note).
- Legal procurement will require changes to our SLA around backup retention; their "no managed backups" ask means we must document and sign an exception.
- Product must triage the HSM requirements (Soojin's notes) and confirm whether we can support wrapped-key boot.

I can draft the staffing and oncall rota (half-day doc) if we agree on the POC window.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Matthew Foster <matthew.foster@catalystanalytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: catalyst-ops@catalystanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment prototype: scope & ops asks

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the level of detail. Catalyst is comfortable with the proposed 3-day POC + 1-week stabilization plan. Two clarifications from our side:
1) We can host a pre-staged private registry; security will open a 2-hour maintenance window for image pulls and updates only during the POC.
2) Our infra team will provide an HSM endpoint that supports wrapped-key boot (we need Redwood to validate the handshake).

Proposed POC dates: Sep 5–7 (engineering setup Sep 4). We can do a 30-min kickoff on Sep 4 09:00 PDT. Matt and our infra lead will join.

Confirming we have the attachments and will review the runbook this week. Please confirm the final staffing doc so we can issue the purchase order.

Thanks,
Matt Foster
Director of Platform Engineering
Catalyst Analytics
